about.description: ETF perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking the Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X ETF, cash-settled, 24/7, up to 5x leverage, margined in USDC, hourly funding. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-09-21: mark $22.31, open interest $19.16K, 24h volume $7.59K. Added 2026-09-21 in the third Ondo Perps expansion batch, taking the registry from 45 to 56 RWA markets; the adapter's 65 live rows include 9 crypto perps (BTC, ENA, ETH, HYPE, ONDO, PUMP, SOL, XRP, ZEC) that are out of scope.
